- The field names by which the P4 session and the P6 notice response expose the team scope and the queue code are Not specified in the source documents (GAP-0344; ASM-0438); the suite reads them from the published contracts and fails the preflight if a field is absent.
- Role version: no role or permission row count, role-file layout, conflict version label, matrix effective-date column, full conflict list or MSG-P4-006 text is Not specified in the source documents (GAP-0985); the suite seeds exactly the rows of the approved role file and cites GAP-0985 wherever a value is missing.
- Reader caching: a reader keeps no table copy of queue or role data and may cache a read only for the life of one call; a longer-lived cache is a contract of the owner with a version and an invalidation event (GAP-1177). The P4 guard cache is used only as the rwb-access contract publishes it.

  Scenario: AC13 A suite step cannot read a service schema directly (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the suite module of RWB-ITG-W1J01-ITG is built
    When the suite module is checked for any client or connection to a service schema
    Then no step, client or connection to the schema of rwb_case, rwb_access or rwb_comms exists in the suite
    Then the run reads each queue, role, scope and notice value only through the published contracts

  Scenario: AC14 The architecture rules of the business rules hold across the run (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the call set of the run is recorded for the wave 1 services
    When the boundary test reads the call set and the stored tables
    Then the assignment method of every queue row is one of ROUND_ROBIN, LOWEST_LOAD, NAMED_OWNER or SKILL, read from LOV-ASSIGN
    Then every queue, role, scope and notice read in the run answers the same version on the same date
    Then the queue tables exist in rwb_case only and no queue row is held in rwb_comms or rwb_access
    Then each queue row carries the role code it points at and no role row is copied into a queue table
    Then each team scope answer is derived from a queue membership row in force, and a case outside the team answers status 404
    Then the delegation-of-authority version and the queue version pass the same load, check, four-eyes approval, dated effect and one-call rollback
    Then every list of values and parameter is read through a rwb-case contract and no value is written in code
    Then every call is one hop to its owning service inside the 2 s client budget and no service is called through another service

  Scenario: AC15 A consumed call that fails or does not answer is never read as a pass (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the harness holds a fault on one consumed call of rwb-case or rwb-access
    When the consumed call returns a server error or does not answer inside 2 s
    Then the call is retried once under the suite policy and the evidence report records the retry
    Then no assertion is made on data that was not read, and the step ends as failed if the retry also fails
    Then a load whose rwb-access role read does not answer inside 2 s is refused with status 503 and nothing is written
